name: Radio, frequencies and operating
description: Official documents about radio that can be kept offline: the UK, United States and Canadian rules for amateur and licence-free radio, marine radio licensing, frequency allocation tables, emergency communications field guides, time and weather broadcast guides, European agreements on amateur licences, and the International Amateur Radio Union's band plans and operating guides. Each PDF is fetched from its publisher's own website; the question-and-answer archives come from Kiwix.
